headline: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview hits an all-time-high 1.0% share; DeepSeek still rules at 39.2%
summary: Baidu's ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview set a fresh all-time token-share record at 1.0%, the day's headline. Meanwhile DeepSeek holds 39.2% of provider share, and its V4.1 Flash still sits on top of the leaderboard at 29.1%.
highlights: The top three providers hold 56.9% between them: DeepSeek, Tencent, and OpenAI.
Meta's muse-ember enters the leaderboard at rank 47 with 0.3% of tokens.
Xiaomi's mimo-v2.6-flash climbs 14 spots over seven days to rank 10.
Grok 4.7 jumps 11 places in a day to rank 39.
Google's gemma-4-26b drops out after its last ranking at 51.
